description: This file contains function prototypes for the Broadway Web Resource Manager Module Container Object (BWRM MCO), including creation, removal, enrollment, and initialization functions, as well as a factory function for creating module containers.

methods.name: BwrmCreateModuleContainer
methods.description: Creates and returns a handle to a new Module Container object, given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BwrmMcoCreate
methods.description: Creates a new instance of the Module Container Object, given container, owner, and reserved contexts.

methods.name: BwrmMcoRemove
methods.description: Removes or deallocates the specified Module Container Object.

methods.name: BwrmMcoEnrollObjects
methods.description: Enrolls or registers objects within the Module Container Object.
